name: Isolation amplifier
summary: Transfers an analogue measurement across the documented electrical isolation boundary.
description: Transfers an analogue measurement across the documented electrical isolation boundary.

On a schematic, identify the two supply domains, input reference and output interface and trace the isolated measurement signal and downstream processing. Keep the component tag and signal/reference names consistent across the control drawing, terminal schedule and device documentation.
An isolation amplifier has an analogue signal-transfer role; a digital isolator transfers encoded logic rather than a generic continuous voltage.

The preview is an independently drawn educational functional reference. Add the selected component’s actual power pins, terminal numbers, timing or analogue reference details when producing a construction drawing.
